Label: Psychopathic Personality Inventory - Revised
Description: Psychopathic Personality Inventory - Revised (PPI-R). Measures psychopathic personality traits (e.g. fearless dominance, self-centered impulsivity, coldheartedness). 154 items, 4-point scale. Reference: Lilienfeld, S. O., & Widows, M. R. (2005). Psychopathic Personality Inventory-Revised (PPI-R): Professional manual. Lutz, FL: Psychological Assessment Resources. German version: Alpers, G. W., & Eisenbarth, H. (2008). PPI-R. Psychopathic Personality Inventory-Revised. Deutsche Version. Göttingen: Hogrefe.
